اصطخموا (form VIII)
# اِصْطَخَمُوا (iṣṭaḵamū) /isˤ.tˤa.xa.muː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِصْطَخَمَ (iṣṭaḵama)
# اِصْطَخِمُوا (iṣṭaḵimū) /isˤ.tˤa.xi.muː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِصْطَخَمَ (iṣṭaḵama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
